critical_error_policy: A missing or contradicted critical requirement is a critical error. This pilot score tests the judge path only and cannot establish arm superiority.

criteria.requirement: The feature is PA-scoped and optional; shared kernel behavior remains product-neutral and Coding CLI is not changed by default.
Omission preserves per-run classifier model behavior; an explicit empty or unregistered value fails startup visibly.
Only both automatic permission-classification stages use the selected model; normal and post-tool turns retain their run model.
Classifier failure never changes model, while existing same-model retry and permission failure semantics remain.
The running Gateway keeps its bound choice until restart; no new hot-reload path is promised.
The spec asks the Author to ground repo facts and preserves architecture boundaries without dictating design topology.
